A LETTER, JUST FOR YOU

A little note.
Just for you.

Happy Birthday, Arwa.

I hope today brings you lovely surprises, endless laughs, and everything that makes your heart genuinely happy. You deserve a brand-new year filled with unforgettable memories, exciting adventures, and countless reasons to smile.

I also want you to know how deeply I believe in you and in your future. You have this rare spark and so much talent—I just know you're destined to build something truly big and make a real mark. Keep shining, believe in yourself, and whatever you do, don't get lazy, Ms. "Om Ali" 😉!

And honestly, making this little surprise was a pretty irresistible excuse to remind you how effortlessly stunning you are. That smile of yours has a rare charm that lights up the world and is honestly impossible to forget.

And since today is all about total honesty... I really have to say it, sorry but I just can't keep it to myself anymore: I absolutely love your curve and that gorgeous shape of yours. There's honestly no one quite like you.

Have the loveliest day,
someone who thinks you’re truly one of a kind ♥
